value.before: Hi, I'm Hale, and Maya just added you to this family chat so I can help plan the kids' year. I only read and write in this chat, you don't need to sign up for anything or install anything, and the family's plan already covers everyone here. If you'd rather I didn't write to you, just say so in any words you like and I'll stop for you alone.
